maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost keypoints are distributed in a sparse linear formation approximately 1.5 spot-diameters superior to the primary dense cluster, aligned at a roughly 15-degree upward angle relative to the horizontal plane of the philtrum.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 45% melanin saturation concentrated along the superior dorsal margin and the vertical median groove (philtrum), with the remaining 55% exhibiting light pink/flesh-toned pigmentation.
